title: dengueriskcdmx: Data, Rasters and Code for the Dengue Transmission Risk Map of the Mexico City Metropolitan Area
description: R package with the Aedes aegypti ovitrap data (2017–2024, with training and test partitions), the external validation data (2025), the study area, the Quarto code of the machine-learning workflow (vignettes) and the rasters (about 500 m) of the probability of Aedes aegypti occurrence, the probability of confirmed imported dengue cases and the five-level epidemiological risk map for the Mexico City Metropolitan Area. Confirmed dengue case data are not distributed.
